items.title: Overview
items.text: Says how much space you can free and which step to take first.

items.title: Folders
items.text: Every folder sorted by size, as a list, as tiles or as rings.

items.title: Large Files & Search
items.text: Finds big files and any name in seconds, without a new scan.

items.title: Clean Up
items.text: Removes caches, old logs and leftovers that macOS rebuilds anyway.

items.title: Duplicates
items.text: Spots files that exist twice and moves the extra copies to the Trash.

items.title: Unused Apps
items.text: Lists the apps you have not opened for months, with their size.

items.title: Menu bar
items.text: Shows the free space at a glance and warns you when it runs low.

items.title: Widget
items.text: Keeps the free space on your desktop or in Notification Center.

items.title: Report
items.text: Saves every category and the largest files as a text file.
